docs.title: Welcome to Azure Hybrid Cloud Learning Platform
docs.text:
A complete Azure learning platform focused on building real-world cloud and hybrid infrastructure skills.

  • ☁️ Azure Administration

    Learn Azure services, identity, networking, security, and management.

  • 🌐 Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure

    Master Windows Server, Active Directory, Azure Arc, and hybrid environments.

  • ⚙️ Infrastructure as Code

    Automate Azure deployments using Terraform.

  • 🏗️ Real-World Enterprise Projects

    Build solutions similar to enterprise production environments.

  • 🎯 Certification Preparation

    Prepare for AZ-900, AZ-104, AZ-800 and cloud engineering roles.
